mentions.name: lockboot
mentions.description: A verifiable cloud infrastructure stack that uses UEFI SecureBoot and vTPM to establish a cloud root-of-trust, proving that code released on GitHub/GitLab is what is actually running on GCP/EC2 (with Azure and AliYun support planned). It takes a trust model different from SGX/TDX that aims to be more pragmatic, easier, and cheaper. Current work includes a Docker-to-verifiable-cloud-VM flow, with gVisor support next.
mentions.problem: Many Web3 companies perform on-chain theater with verified contracts and audits while their actual infrastructure is deployed on EC2 or Vercel in unverified 'Trust Me Bro' mode, with no proof that deployed infra matches released code.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Currently hacking away at https://github.com/lockboot

Using UEFI SecureBoot + vTPM for cloud root-of-trust, a stack to prove what's released on github/gitlab is what's actually running on GCP/EC2 (and soon Azure & AliYun).
